locations.note: Newspaperman Jerrod Wilson leaves Brooklyn Heights in 1848 to seek his brother in California.
All routes west converge on Sacramento, Sutter's Fort and nearby Coloma, where the gold is.
The Panama route: by ship to the isthmus, then on foot through a jungle of snakes, quicksand and hostile tribes to the Pacific side.
A playable sea route to California rounds Cape Horn.
The overland route crosses the Sierra Nevada.
The journey ends at the gold fields near Coloma.

routes.name: Via Panama
routes.note: The sea journey reaches Panama, crosses the isthmus overland, then continues by ship to California.

routes.name: Around Cape Horn
routes.note: A long sea voyage rounds Cape Horn before reaching California.

routes.name: Overland
routes.note: The overland trek crosses the Great Plains and mountain ranges on the way to California.
